title: The refusal-ending tag '(no dawn)' on the two kneel options is never defined in any text the player sees at that point — its meaning (a story-ending, no-continuation choice) is only inferable from a separate status line seen much earlier ('Kneeling to the king ends your story').
where: Throne of the Barrow, 'kneel and take his place'; The Hollow Throne, 'kneel to the hollow seat'
